email.subject: Paying for the opening order
email.text:
Hi Kopi Lane team,

Thanks again for the samples. We'd like to go ahead with 25 kg of the Lane House Blend at AUD 38 a kilo for our Surry Hills opening, so AUD 950 in total.

Could you send me a link so I can pay by card today? We'd like it settled before the delivery on Friday.

Thanks,
Mia Tran
Harbour Lane Café Pty Ltd
